description: The paper map screen (pause > MAP, or the map button in game): zoom and pan, the player arrow, the page arrows, which page Up and Down turn to, where the player arrow stands on each page, and the map marks (sprites of the marking textures and where each one goes). Pages are named as in paper_maps.json. Colours are [r, g, b] in 0..255 as the original primitives take them. The keys starting with '_' explain the key of the same name. A mod patches it with its own menu/map_screen.json (newest mod first).

zoom.description: Cross zooms in to twice the size around the player arrow and back. step: zoom change per frame (Q12, 4096 = 1.0). focus_offset: added to the arrow's cell to centre it. pan_max: pan limit in map cells. cursor_divisor: the pan per frame is left stick value * 16384 / divisor (Q12).

_image_shade: Grey level of the map image and of the marks (128 = the texture as it is).

player_arrow.description: The player arrow, a triangle in map cells: the tip is "tip" cells ahead of the player, the back corners "back" cells behind and half_width to each side. outline: the colour of the closed line around it.

page_arrows.description: Triangles at the top and the bottom edge, shown when Up or Down turns to a page the player has (tip at y = -tip_y / +tip_y, base at base_y).

_links: Page shown by Up / Down from a page (only when the player has it).
_page_files: Disc files of each page: image is the map picture (MP_*.TIM), markings the marking texture (MR_*.TIM; a page without one draws no marks). Opening the map or turning a page loads the image; the marking texture loads only when it differs from the one already in memory.
_player_placement: Where the player arrow stands on a page. Each group lists pages and rules; the first rule whose conditions all hold places the arrow, no rule = no arrow. Conditions: maps (the current map is one of them), cells (the player's world cell [x, z]; a cell is 40 m, cell -1 starts at 0 and goes down), chunks ([x, z] counted from 1 above 0 and from -1 at 0 and below), cell_z_below, cell_x_in [lo, hi]. Result: x and z, each a map point or a grid {from: x, -x, z or -z of the position plus add metres, divided by 2^shift toward zero, plus offset}, or anchor {grid of player_anchors; x and z as [mul, div] applied to the position inside the cell from its centre}; turn: degrees added to the player's heading.
_player_anchors: Where the player arrow stands on the school and hospital pages: the map point of each world cell (cells[x - first_cell.x][z - first_cell.z] = [map x, map y]); the position inside the cell is added to it.
_marking_atlases: Sprites of the marking textures (mr_*.tim): [u, v, w, h]. A mark names its sprites by number from 1; 0 = none.
_markings: Marks of a page: at = [x, y] in half map pixels from the centre, sprites = [first half, second half]. Each mark has two event flags, one per half, in a run of consecutive save bits: flag is the name of the bit of slot flag_slot (slot = 2 * mark + half, default 0), the other slots follow it. A half is drawn when its flag is set and its sprite is not 0.
